title: Agent store: drop record forms for unknown users, and unused jmap deps
description: Since step 5 (6aae2bb) records never come from JMAP objects, so nothing makes Sender::Unknown or a None user in Participant/Ban (record.rs docs say so). Removing them changes the schema (bump SCHEMA_VERSION; no migration per §7.10) and touches sync, project, render. Also mimid-agent-jmap's Cargo.toml lists sha2 and ulid, unused in src since before step 5.
close_reason: bdbc1d0 on branch chat-delete: Sender::Unknown and Option users removed, SCHEMA_VERSION 2 (others refused), ulid dropped from mimid-agent-jmap, sha2 kept only as dev-dep for tests/two_accounts.rs
